# Daily Briefing – Friday 27 November

Yesterday was a tough one. No training session logged, 7,292 steps, and only 2.3 hours of sleep — that last number is the one that stands out most. Your body burned 2,105 calories, so you're sitting just under your 2,300 target, which is fine, but that sleep is a real concern.

Your HRV tells the story clearly: 57ms against your baseline of 88-117ms is significantly suppressed. That's your body waving a flag. Even with stress at a manageable 43/100, the sleep deprivation is dragging recovery down hard. Today is not a day to push intensity — keep any session light movement or an easy walk only.

Prioritise sleep above everything today. Even a 20-minute nap helps, but aim for 8+ hours tonight. Hit your 175g protein regardless — it protects muscle when recovery is compromised. Chester is 195 days away; protecting today is part of winning then. 💪
